content:
I highly recommend putting your Core One on a sturdy turntable for this entire conversion.  The instructions frequently bounce around from front of the machine to the side, then to the back and around again.
The turntable makes it much less painful as you only have to raise the printer twice - once to put it on the turntable and once to take it off.  It will also keep the rubber feet from ripping off as it gets slid around.
